description.value: The Daajing Giids branch of the Vancouver Island Regional Library has served this remote Haida Gwaii community since 1983 and is housed in the refurbished Community Hall. Situated on the traditional territory of the Haida Nation, it is one of the few public indoor spaces available to touring cyclists exploring the archipelago. The branch offers free public Wi-Fi and public computer access, making it a practical waypoint in an area with limited connectivity.
